evidenceNote: Screening Gaussian-plume footprint driven by real NASA GEOS-FP analysed winds at the site. chi/Q is dilution per unit emission; it is not a measured or predicted concentration unless an emission rate with a stated source is supplied. No chemistry, deposition, downwash or terrain.

assumptions.stability: Pasquill class from 10 m wind; day = moderate insolation, night = >= 4/8 cloud
assumptions.dispersion: Briggs (1973) urban sigma curves, valid 100 m to 10000 m
assumptions.effectiveStackHeightNote: Assumed for screening; no published stack/exhaust data were available.
